section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1984
title: 31 ## Distribution of suicides according to age : The statistics of suicides by age-group revealed that the highest number of suicides (22,433) was committed by persons belonging to the age-group of 18-30 years i.e. 44·4% of the total suicides reported in the country and the lowest (6,525) was committed by the persons above 50 years of age sharing 12·9 per cent of the total suicides in the country. The total number of suicides committed by the persons between 30 to 50 years of age was (14,422), which registered 28·5 per cent of total suicides in India while the persons below 18 years of age accounted for 14·2 per cent of the total suicides reported during 1984 registering a total number of 7,191 suicides cases. The age-wise distribution of suicides for all the States together and the country as a whole was almost the same during 1984 and it was almost the same for the Union Territories and the Metropolitan Cities also as a whole.
